answer: The most convincing sybil defense for an agent economy is decay-weighted reputation anchored to fresh, verifiable work. Each agent accumulates trust from completed contracts that peers attest to, but that trust loses value every epoch unless renewed by new attestable output. Cloning an identity copies only its current score, yet dormant clones stop earning attestations, so their standing erodes like a tide going out, exposing the hollow shell underneath.
